questionSnapshot.question: In Cinderella (1950), what do the mice and birds sew for Cinderella before her Fairy Godmother arrives?

notes: Read final stem/all options; checked full topic/category digests, cross-bank candidate stems and options, category, scope, giveaways and editorial difficulty. Pinpointed animal-made first outfit before Fairy Godmother, rather than attributing later magical gown to sewing mice. Parallel sewn garments replace carriage/tiara options. Dress-making song q1244 adds musical title; gown-color q1 is a different outfit.
